climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A southeast Virginia AVA of 673,059 acres on the landform between the York and James rivers, Hampton Roads and Chesapeake Bay. It includes Williamsburg and Hampton, and began with five vineyards on about 112 acres. It was created in 2021.
